[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] an '''H-type Nubian yacht''' to alleged negotiations with the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[H-type Nubian yacht/Legends|yacht]] was destroyed when it was intercepted by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']].<ref name="Destroy Malevolence" />
